summary: CFTC_TFF_FACTOR_SEMANTIC_BOUNDARY_READY. The accepted source design and disabled V2 contract explicitly seal the publisher, report family, futures-only variant, CME Bitcoin market and contract code; four named participant categories; long, short and spread representations; absolute positions, changes, percentages of open interest, trader counts and concentration families; raw contract-unit, percentage, count and concentration-unit boundaries; Tuesday observation and Friday/holiday-aware release timing; strictly-post-receipt eligibility; and explicit absence, suppression, duplicate, malformed, family-drift, future-date, release-not-due, unavailable and same-date-byte-drift states. Those pre-outcome semantics are sufficient for Manager to freeze one later concrete single-factor preregistration question by selecting exactly one input family, one normalization unit, one leakage-safe eligibility rule and one missingness rule before values or outcomes are opened. This audit selects no field, category, formula, transform, sign, threshold, horizon or strategy mapping. It is NON_COUNTING/NON_COUNTING_NOT_APPLICABLE. Immediate fee-adjusted PnL and drawdown effects are zero; continuity, operations, prediction and economics remain MISSING_PROOF.
